description: The naming scope of Multi-brand: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: naming.roles
answers.why: Components get their own keys, shared by every brand.

answers.question: naming.definition
answers.why: Role names stay the same in every brand.

answers.question: naming.values
answers.why: Lowercase paths read the same everywhere.

answers.question: naming.lands
answers.why: Components never change; brand primitives do.

usage.use: The closest semantic token, then ask for a new one
usage.not: A raw value or a brand primitive in the component
usage.why: A raw value shows the same in every brand, so it breaks the theme.
